# watchpoint_domain_verification (Resource)

A DNS domain verification. Creating it issues a TXT-record token; publish that record and (optionally) trigger the verify check. The domain cannot be changed in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  # Set verify = true to check DNS immediately after the record is published.
  verify = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain to verify (e.g. `example.com`).

### Optional

- `verify` (Boolean) When true, the provider triggers the DNS verify check once immediately after creation. Failures (e.g. DNS not yet propagated) are ignored. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Domain verification ID.
- `status` (String) Verification status (e.g. `Pending`, `Verified`).
- `txt_record_value` (String) DNS TXT record value to publish for verification.
- `verification_token` (String) Verification token generated by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_domain_verification.example dv_001
```
